dataset.institution: Czech Technical University in Prague, Stratosphere Laboratory
dataset.attribution: Valeros, Veronica; Garcia, Sebastian (2024), CTU Hornet 65 Niner: A Network Dataset of Geographically Distributed Low-Interaction Honeypots, Mendeley Data V1, DOI 10.17632/nt4p9zsv5k.1.
dataset.nature: Observed Internet traffic to dedicated cloud honeypots; not a production-victim incident corpus or expert-adjudicated QA set.
dataset.paper_scope_checked: Bibliographic record and abstract; current full article fetch was blocked (PMC browser check, publisher403); not a fresh full-text audit.

access.previous_issue: Original mcfp host TLS chain failed in earlier review.
access.resolved_route: Official Mendeley public API and public-files HTTPS, TLS validation enabled. No retries against the old broken host.
access.initial_attempt: 4MiB directory budget rejected before any full download; exited1. Successful retries used bounded ranges. Initial failed-range transfer total was not separately metered.

selection.reason: First non-boundary sample day chosen before event-content inspection; two geographically separated observed hosts. Not a random or representative sample.
selection.ssh_absence_limit: No SSH log members in these two archive listings; not proof that SSH service or sensor was disabled, nor proof of zero successful attacks.
selection.split: Review exposed. Other geos/dates are not automatically an independent test; cross-source/campaign overlap must be audited first.

limitations: No per-flow adjudicated attack/benign labels inferred.
Authentication observation is not business authorization or proof of compromise.
Zero loss estimates and no exact alerts do not establish complete capture or benign activity.
Source addresses are historical observations, not current blocklist entries.
The filename day is selection metadata, not proof of its timezone.

findings.capture_health: 192 zero loss estimates have acks=0/gaps=0, alongside 192 Too_Little_Traffic notices. 572 zero pkts_dropped and 19,772 zero missed_bytes observations do not prove full capture. No actual loss or outage is asserted from the notices alone.

source_overlap.interpretation: Shared historical source address is a split-leakage warning, not proof of a common actor or campaign.

findings.precision_policy: Preserve Decimal seconds and original fractional digits in KST display. Representation precision is not clock accuracy. Filename timezone is not inferred.
findings.date_boundary: Two inspected ZIP directories list 65 dates, 2024-04-28 through 2024-07-01. README/repository starts Apr28 while article abstract says Apr29; retain this discrepancy. Selected conn start times can precede the filename day boundary.

ctu_sme_followup.reason: Large sequential tar.bz2 archives deferred; this turn used smaller selectable Hornet ZIP members.

failed_attempt.r1_error: Rejected timestamps with greater than microsecond precision in both geo1 and geo9; no result emitted.

validation.version_limit: Zeek v7.1.0 documentation is a field-semantics reference, not evidence of the dataset capture engine version.

execution_scope.deploy_offline_changes: not applicable: no service, package or policy change
